title: The bait mode on the owner's first predator values, the values to paste (C), and Isao's fly-over (trapped, under the creature, at random)
context: Owner, 2026-10-09: 'to begin set default chase speed 3, reach duration 5, reach sweep 4, size 40. foot grip 3. 2) add a method to quickly copy-paste the values in lab mode for me to paste here. 3) Isao gets stuck between an invisible wall (the boundaries) and the creature too often. once in a while have Isao fly OVER it ... 4) The gunship camera roll is good, the gunsight is good. Predator Feel we need to hone in.' Then: 'Isao gets stuck too easily under the creature.' On refactor-run (not pushed), after 2026-10-09-boss-bait-arena-and-feel-landed. Bait mode only; the tank mode keeps 30 m and its slower preset.
outcome: (1) NIH_DAIRIA_PREDATOR is chase speed 3, reach duration 5, reach sweep 4, foot grip 3 (the rest as before); NIH_DAIRIA_PREDATOR_SIZE_METRES 40 is set on entering bait mode, 30 on entering tank mode. (2) src/labs/boss/settings-copy.js: the C key (also from the seat, through the lab's capture listener that already routes R) and the 'copy settings (C)' button copy a block, one line a group: 'mode=bait variant=nih-dairia size=40' / 'motion: speed=3 reachTime=5 ...' (all 14) / 'phys: gravity=2.4 iterations=3 feeding=true instinct=true' / 'bait: altitude=4 erratic=1 health=180 reload=6 hopChance=0.03' / 'fight: ' the fight folder's knobs and switches that moved from where the panel started ('defaults' when none) / 'fear: ' every fear number. The old JSON is gone: nothing read it back. COPIED on the clipboard, else the box under the buttons holds it selected (headless has no clipboard: the box). (3) The fly-over, pure in src/domain/boss-bait.js (hopBait, startHop, trappedBait, underBait; content in BOSS_FIGHT.bait): trapped = the bound within trapBound 12 m and a floor contact on the inside within trapNear 25 m for trapFor 0.8 s; random = hopChance 0.03 a second (its own seeded sequence; not while panicking), one per hopCooldown 8 s after a landing; the hop climbs at hopClimb 20 m/s to hopAlt 30 m (the body's top measures 11 to 15 m at 40 m), crosses at hopSpeed 22 m/s to keep beyond the creature's edge on its far side (held trapBound + 10 m inside the bound so he does not land trapped), at most hopCross 8 s, and comes down to his altitude; no panic or jink in it; the hold does not count above reachHeight 18 m. UNDER the creature (his ground point within underCore 0.5 of its half-width from its centre, or two floor contacts within underNear 15 m more than 120 degrees apart round him) he escapes at once, cooldown and chance ignored, climbing and flying out through the near side together. The lab: his altitude follows the hop, the readout says 'flying over (phase)', the hop's start says bait_flyover (now recorded; one of the three in turn, at most one each 12 s, the first of a round always), a panel knob 'Isao fly-over chance (/s)', the handle's bait().hop/hopWhy/hops/trapped, hop() and under(). Node: the trapped hop at 0.8 s, a hop 180 degrees round in 5.2 s at 30 m, random hops at 0.0327 a second over 20 runs of 600 s (0.03 asked), the escape from under 8 m clear in 0.32 s at worst. --boss-bait (green, commit 9aed219b, final run): a forced hop 135 degrees round the creature's centre (178 to 184 in five earlier runs; the creature moves under him) at 30 m over a top of 14.8 m, landed in 7.2 s (5.2 to 6.9 before); a squeezed bound has him hop in 1.8 s, trapped (in two runs 'under' at 1.0 s: the creature lunged onto him first); under its centre he is clear of the body (8 m from every contact and beyond its 20 m half-width) in 1.2 to 1.8 s, never taken. The bound's backstop now checks the nodes themselves when the body's centre seems clear of the edge: the predator's arms outreach its rest extent and a contact stood 121.7 m out of 120 in one run (src/labs/boss/arena.js). Test bounds changed with the reasons in the suite: the speed samples (outside panic, the fly-overs and the bound's clamp) need 40 (55 to 158 seen), the scripted kill 120 s of lab clock (74 s, and 90.1 s 1.7 hp short), the MK-9 on Isao runs on a 1000 hp creature (his escapes break the lead and in one run the fifth MK-9 killed the creature on the way). THE OWNER'S VALUES MEASURED: against chase speed 3 / reach 5 / sweep 4 at 40 m the arms sweep out to about 90 m round him and he is under it nearly all the time (in a hop 98 to 100 per cent of a 10 s run in six runs; the median gap to its edge 14.9, -14.2, 1.9, 18.2 m in four runs before the escape existed); the keep, the arena's speed statistics, the trapped case and the aimed runs and kills are asserted on the predator's earlier pursuit and arms (0.22, 10, 1, 1.5 at 30 m), where the keep holds (median 17.2 to 19.3 m), and the owner's values are put back after; the far-side 40 mm led onto an arm's tip of the owner's creature missed (0 of 6) and the 25 mm wore a 60 hp creature only to 44 hp in 90 s. The 40 m checks: the creature's 15 m margin is less than its 20 m half-width, so the backstop does more of the bound's work (contacts 112 to 120 m); Isao's 10 m margin against the creature's 15 m lets its target sit 5 m inside him at the wall (the trapped case); his 20 m keep and the 12 m panic are absolute and the arms now outreach them; the MK-9's 55 m blast on the creature's centre reaches him more often. Not retuned.
alternatives: Keeping the gap and the kills on the owner's values (rejected: the keep does not hold against those arms and the 25 mm wore a 60 hp creature only to 44 hp in 90 s, so the fight's flow could not be tested; the numbers are logged instead)
A trap radius inside his keep (18 m; rejected after the first runs: at the bound with the creature at his keep he could not circle out and was not called trapped)
An under-escape that climbs first and then flies out (rejected: climbing on the spot under the body leaves him in reach for the first 0.7 s)
